subject: Air freight quote to MEX
body:
Hi there,

Hope your week’s going well! Could you quote the fastest air freight option to MEX (Mexico City, MX)? The shipment will be ready for pickup on 2026-11-25 at our site in 24311 (Kiel), Germany. We’d need you to arrange the truck from our site to the departure airport.

It’s sports equipment in 3 pieces, with a gross weight of 1720 kg and a total volume of 14.11 cbm.

Could you send me your all-in price in EUR, including the pickup, and let me know when it would arrive at MEX?

Thanks for checking!

Thanks a lot and have a lovely day!
Petra Hofmann
Export Desk, Hofmann Textilwerk KG

classification.reasoning: The customer is requesting a new air freight quote for a specified shipment to MEX.
